_README: Expected-destination manifest for TGE (Round 6 / D2 fix). Copy to addresses.<network>.json (e.g. addresses.ethereum.json), fill EVERY field with the FINAL, TRIPLE-CHECKED checksummed address, and commit it to a SEPARATE secure record before TGE. scripts/verify/verify_tge_targets.js and 06_execute_tge.js itself both check the live .env/00_config values against this file (and the chain) before anything is sent; 06_execute_tge.js REFUSES to run on any mismatch, and refuses to run at all without this file on any network other than hardhat/localhost. This is the last line of defence against a mis-set env var sending billions of SRX to a wrong, irreversible address. addresses.<network>.json is gitignored — keep the authoritative copy in your deployment runbook / Safe records.

roles._note: admin, timelock, governor and guardianModule are compared with the live values; on a real network an unpinned (zero) role FAILS the check.

tgeAllocations._note: Destinations MUST match 06_execute_tge.js finalAllocations exactly. Vaults are deployed contracts; liquidity/staking/treasury/strategic are the contracts or Safe wallets that receive direct allocations. For each vesting vault, beneficiary is the address the vault pays out to; it is compared with the deployed vault's beneficiary() and is REQUIRED on a real network.

_invariant: Sum of amountSRX MUST equal 10000000000 (MAX_SUPPLY). verify_tge_targets.js asserts this.
